description: Setup of the product office: an hourly health tick measures the executor host and the MCP endpoint; the setup command lane provisions the MCP token for the office's lanes, keeps the team registry (a team registers itself when provisioned) and pauses or resumes the office.

places.p-product-charter: The product charter: principles, goals, services, coder, budgets, autonomy (the person's; never changed by a net)
places.p-product-setup-cmd: Setup commands (health, provision, pause, resume, register-team)
places.p-product-teams: The team registry: one token per installed service team (service, session, namespace, app route, places)

transitions.label: Setup process
transitions.description: office-infra: health, provision (MCP token into the vault for the office lanes), register-team, pause, resume.
